title: Gap Fill
summary: Of the sessions that opened away from the prior session's close, how often price traded back to that close. The denominator is every session with a gap (roll days excluded by construction); the fill is the conventional touch of the prior close. Slice it by size, direction, weekday, or any registry condition, and read the time-to-fill distribution, not just the rate.

params.name: minGapPct
params.doc: Only gaps at least this large (percent of prior close, absolute).

params.name: maxGapPct
params.doc: Only gaps at most this large (percent of prior close, absolute).

deltas: any composed condition (FVG state, event days, prior-day direction, volatility regime): not a fixed dropdown set
time-to-fill distribution alongside the fill rate
N + 95% CI + stability split on every number
unlimited history: your data decides the depth
